title: Treat a widow's or divorced woman's vow as binding
original_audience: Israelite widows or divorced women who make a vow, through Israel’s tribal heads
verse_text: [30:10] And the vow of a widow or a divorced woman—whatever she vowed concerning herself—shall remain against her.

title: Apply the prescribed purity standard to articles that can or cannot pass through fire
original_audience: Israelite troops returning from the Midianite campaign, as addressed by Moses and Eleazar
verse_text: [31:20] And you shall thoroughly purify every covering, every leather article, every object made from goats’ hair, and every wooden article. [31:21] And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the force who were returning from the battle formation, This is the ordinance of the law that the Lord prescribed unto Moses: [31:22] Only the gold, and the silver, and the bronze, and the iron, and the lead, and the tin, [31:23] everything that passes through fire shall also be cleansed, but it shall be purified with the water of purification. Everything that does not pass through fire shall pass through water.

title: Give the Levites the prescribed towns and surrounding lands in proportion to tribal holdings
original_audience: Israel’s tribes contributing from their allotments, with Levites as recipients
context_note: The Levite families invoke the earlier command. The chapter records its implementation by allotment and the provision of land for their livestock.
verse_text: [35:2] Instruct the sons of Israel to give the Levites towns to live in from their allotted possessions. They shall also give the Levites the outlying lands around the towns. [35:3] And the towns shall be theirs to live in, and their designated lands shall be for their livestock and all their four-footed animals. [35:4] And the lands adjoining the towns that you shall give the Levites shall extend two thousand cubits outward from the town wall all around. [35:5] And you shall measure outside the town two thousand cubits on the eastern side, and two thousand cubits on the southwestern side, and two thousand cubits on the seaward side, and two thousand cubits on the northern side; and the town shall be in the midst thereof for you, together with the adjoining lands of the towns. [35:6] And you shall give the Levites the six cities of refuge that you shall provide for the person who has killed someone to flee to, and in addition to these, forty-two towns. [35:7] All the towns you shall give the Levites shall be forty-eight towns, together with their outlying lands. [35:8] And for the towns that you shall give from the possession of the sons of Israel, take many from those with much and fewer from those with less. Each shall give towns to the Levites according to the inheritance he receives.
maimonides: P183: Give the Levites cities and surrounding land

title: Set apart the appointed cities of refuge
original_audience: Israel’s tribes establishing the cities, with protection for Israelites, sojourners and resident strangers who kill unintentionally
context_note: A direction recorded in this narrative. Its original speaker, recipient and occasion must be retained; recording an order does not establish that God approves it or commands every believer to repeat it.
verse_text: [35:10] Speak unto the sons of Israel, and you shall say unto them: You are crossing the Jordan into the land of Canaan, [35:11] and you shall set apart towns for yourselves. They shall be refuges for the killer to flee there, anyone who has struck a person unintentionally. [35:12] And the towns shall be refuges for you from the kinsman who avenges blood, so that the killer shall in no wise die before standing before the congregation for judgment. [35:13] And the towns you shall provide, the six towns, shall be refuges for you. [35:14] You shall provide three towns across the Jordan, and you shall provide three towns in the land of Canaan. [35:15] There shall be a refuge for the sons of Israel; for the sojourner and the resident stranger among you, these towns shall also be refuges, so that anyone who strikes a person unintentionally may flee there.
maimonides: P182: Set apart cities of refuge and prepare the roads to them

title: Do not execute the manslayer before congregational judgment
original_audience: Israel’s judging congregation and the blood-avenger
verse_text: [35:12] And the towns shall be refuges for you from the kinsman who avenges blood, so that the killer shall in no wise die before standing before the congregation for judgment.
maimonides: N292: Do not execute anyone before trial and conviction

title: Put to death whoever kills with a deadly weapon or in enmity
original_audience: Israel's congregation and judges
context_note: the Lord through Moses addresses Israel's congregation and judges in this passage.
verse_text: [35:16] But if he strikes someone with an iron object and that person dies, he is a murderer. Let the murderer surely be put to death. [35:17] If he strikes someone with a stone from his hand capable of causing death and that person dies, he is a murderer. Let the murderer surely be put to death. [35:18] If he strikes someone with a wooden object from his hand capable of causing death and that person dies, he is a murderer. Let the murderer surely be put to death. [35:20] If he pushes someone out of enmity and throws an object at him from ambush and that person dies, [35:21] or strikes him with his hand out of wrath and he dies, let the one who struck him surely be put to death; he is a murderer. Let the murderer surely be put to death. The kinsman who avenges blood shall kill the murderer when he encounters him.

title: The blood-avenger: execute the condemned murderer under the prescribed judgment
original_audience: The kinsman acting as blood-avenger under Israel’s homicide law
verse_text: [35:19] The kinsman who avenges blood shall himself kill the murderer. When he encounters him, he shall kill him.

title: Judge intent and circumstances to distinguish murder from accidental killing
original_audience: The Israelite congregation judging between the killer and the blood-avenger
context_note: The woodcutting example applies the existing distinction between accidental and intentional killing. The text connects refuge to lack of prior hatred and distance from safety.
verse_text: [35:22] But if he suddenly pushes someone without enmity, or throws any object at him without ambush, [35:23] or, without his knowing, a stone capable of causing death falls upon him and he dies, though he was not his enemy and was not seeking to harm him, [35:24] And then the congregation shall judge between the one who struck him and the kinsman who avenges blood according to these judgments. [35:25] And the congregation shall rescue the killer from the kinsman who avenges blood and restore him to the city of refuge to which he fled. He shall live there until the high priest dies, whom they anointed with the holy oil.

title: Congregation: rescue the accidental killer from the avenger of blood
original_audience: The Israelite congregation deciding an accidental-killing case
verse_text: [35:25] And the congregation shall rescue the killer from the kinsman who avenges blood and restore him to the city of refuge to which he fled. He shall live there until the high priest dies, whom they anointed with the holy oil.
maimonides: P225: Exile the accidental killer to a city of refuge

title: Remain in the city of refuge until the high priest dies
original_audience: An accidental killer assigned to an Israelite refuge city
context_note: Verse 27 gives the specific boundary consequence, the avenger is not liable for killing the person outside the city. Verse 28 states the return provision after the high priest dies. Keep both with the residence rule.
verse_text: [35:25] And the congregation shall rescue the killer from the kinsman who avenges blood and restore him to the city of refuge to which he fled. He shall live there until the high priest dies, whom they anointed with the holy oil. [35:26] But if the killer goes outside the boundaries of the city to which he fled, [35:27] and the kinsman who avenges blood finds him outside the boundaries of his city of refuge and kills the killer, the avenger is not liable. [35:28] For he must live in the city of refuge until the high priest dies. After the death of the high priest, the killer may return to the land of his possession.
maimonides: P225: Exile the accidental killer to a city of refuge

title: Congregation: return the accidental killer to the city of refuge
original_audience: The Israelite congregation deciding an accidental-killing case
verse_text: [35:25] And the congregation shall rescue the killer from the kinsman who avenges blood and restore him to the city of refuge to which he fled. He shall live there until the high priest dies, whom they anointed with the holy oil.
maimonides: P225: Exile the accidental killer to a city of refuge

title: Do not accept ransom for a condemned murderer
original_audience: Israel’s authorities administering the homicide judgment
verse_text: [35:31] And you shall not accept a ransom for a life from the killer who is guilty and liable to be killed; he shall surely be put to death.
maimonides: N295: Do not accept ransom to spare a convicted murderer

title: Do not accept ransom to release the manslayer before the high priest's death
original_audience: Israel’s authorities administering refuge for an accidental killer
verse_text: [35:32] You shall not accept a ransom concerning flight to a city of refuge, allowing him to live in the land again before the high priest dies.
maimonides: N296: Do not accept ransom to release a manslayer from refuge early

title: Do not pollute the land with bloodshed
original_audience: Israel living in its allotted land
context_note: The Lord connects bloodshed with defilement of the land where he dwells among Israel. Verse 33 says atonement for shed blood comes only by the blood of the one who shed it.
verse_text: [35:33] And you shall in no wise stain with murder the land wherein you dwell; for this blood stains the land with murder, and atonement shall not be made for the land for the blood shed upon it, except by the blood of him who shed it. [35:34] And you shall not defile the land in which you dwell, in which I will dwell among you, for I am the Lord, dwelling among the sons of Israel.

title: An inheriting daughter: marry within the father's clan under the tribal-land provision
original_audience: Zelophehad’s daughters and other daughters inheriting ancestral land among Israel’s tribes
verse_text: [36:6] This is the word that the Lord prescribed concerning Zelophehad’s daughters: Let them marry whom they please, but they shall marry from their father’s clan.

title: Preserve ancestral tribal allotments against transfer to another tribe
original_audience: Israel’s tribes and holders of ancestral allotments
verse_text: [36:7] And no inheritance among the sons of Israel shall pass from tribe to tribe, for each Israelite shall hold fast to the inheritance of his ancestral tribe.

title: Hear disputes and judge Israelites and resident sojourners justly
original_audience: Israel’s appointed judges, hearing disputes between fellow Israelites and involving resident sojourners
verse_text: [1:16] And I commanded your judges at that time, saying: Hear the matters between your brethren, and judge justly between a man and his brother and the sojourner with him.

title: Do not show partiality between great and small
original_audience: Israel's appointed judges
verse_text: [1:17] You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall judge the small and the great alike. You shall not shrink before the face of man, for judgment belongs unto God. And you shall bring unto me the matter which is too hard for you, and I will hear it.
maimonides: N284: Do not appoint a judge unlearned in the law

title: Do not fear human pressure in judgment
original_audience: Israel's appointed judges
verse_text: [1:17] You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall judge the small and the great alike. You shall not shrink before the face of man, for judgment belongs unto God. And you shall bring unto me the matter which is too hard for you, and I will hear it.
maimonides: N276: A judge must not fear a litigant or intimidator

title: Do not add to or take away from the word God commanded
original_audience: Israel
context_note: An application under review does not remove the command from the catalogue or pronounce a forbidden act permissible.
verse_text: [4:2] You shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it; you shall keep the commandments of the Lord your God, which I command you this day.
maimonides: N313: Do not add to the Torah's commandments
N314: Do not subtract from the Torah's commandments

title: Teach God's words and acts to children and grandchildren
original_audience: Israelites who witnessed the Horeb revelation and were charged to teach their children and grandchildren
context_note: The parental role continues; exact ancient dates, physical signs and public ceremonies are evaluated separately.
verse_text: [4:9] Take heed unto yourself, and guard your soul diligently, lest you forget all the things which your eyes have seen, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life. And you shall teach your sons and your sons’ sons [4:10] the day when you stood before the Lord your God in Horeb, in the day of the assembly, when the Lord said unto me: Assemble the people unto Me, and let them hear My words, that they may learn to fear Me all the days that they live upon the earth, and may teach their sons.
maimonides: P11: Study Torah and teach it

title: Do not bow down to or serve the heavenly bodies
original_audience: Israel
verse_text: [4:19] And lest you lift up your eyes unto heaven, and see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, and all the adornment of heaven, and be led astray to bow down unto them and serve them, which the Lord your God has allotted unto all the nations under heaven.

title: Love the Lord with heart, soul and strength
original_audience: Israel
verse_text: [6:5] And you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your strength.
maimonides: P3: Love God

title: Teach children and speak of God’s words throughout ordinary daily life
topic: Marriage, family and care for parents
original_audience: Israelite households entrusted with teaching God’s words to their children
verse_text: [6:7] And you shall teach them to your sons, and speak of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk in the way, and when you lie down, and when you rise up.
maimonides: P10: Recite the Shema morning and evening
P11: Study Torah and teach it

title: Write God's words on doorposts and gates
original_audience: Israelite householders addressed by Moses
verse_text: [6:9] And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your houses and of your gates.
maimonides: P15: Affix God's words (mezuzah) to doorposts and gates

title: Swear by God's name in the prescribed covenant allegiance
original_audience: Israel, when making an oath in the stated covenant setting
context_note: Christians differ about solemn judicial oaths. Ancient rules for household annulment are not automatically reproduced in Christian households.
verse_text: [6:13] You shall fear the Lord your God, and you shall serve Him, and you shall cleave unto Him, and you shall swear by His name.
maimonides: P7: Swear by God's name when an oath is required

title: Do not put God to the test
original_audience: Israel
context_note: Luke records Jesus citing the existing prohibition when challenged to test God. Keep the Deuteronomy requirement as primary.
verse_text: [6:16] You shall not put the Lord your God to the test, as you tested Him at Testing.
maimonides: N64: Do not test God (or His true prophet) unduly

title: Do not intermarry with the specified idolatrous Canaanite peoples
original_audience: Israel entering Canaan in relation to the seven peoples named in Deuteronomy 7:1–2
context_note: Moses gives the prohibition in the context of Israel’s entry into Canaan and identifies its purpose as preventing a turn to the service of other gods.
verse_text: [7:3] Neither shall you intermarry with them; you shall not give your daughter unto his son, nor take his daughter for your son.
maimonides: N52: Do not intermarry with idolatrous nations

title: Do not covet the silver or gold on idols
original_audience: Israel confronting the inhabitants' idols
verse_text: [7:25] You shall burn the graven images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or gold upon them, nor take it unto yourself, lest you stumble thereby; for it is an abomination unto the Lord your God.
maimonides: N22: Do not benefit from idols' silver or gold ornaments

title: Do not take the silver or gold from idols
original_audience: Israel confronting the inhabitants' idols
verse_text: [7:25] You shall burn the graven images of their gods with fire. You shall not covet the silver or gold upon them, nor take it unto yourself, lest you stumble thereby; for it is an abomination unto the Lord your God.
maimonides: N22: Do not benefit from idols' silver or gold ornaments

title: Do not bring a devoted idolatrous object into your house
original_audience: Israelite households
verse_text: [7:26] And you shall not bring an abomination into your house, lest you become a thing under the ban, like unto it. You shall utterly reject it, and utterly abhor it, for it is a thing under the ban.
maimonides: N25: Do not bring an idol or its accessories into your house

title: Bless the Lord after eating and being satisfied in the good land
original_audience: Israelites eating and satisfied from the produce of the land the Lord gives them
verse_text: [8:10] And you shall eat and be filled, and bless the Lord your God upon the good land which He has given you.
maimonides: P19: Bless God after eating (grace after meals)

title: Do not worship the Lord by adopting the nations’ condemned practices
original_audience: Israelites in the land, warned against imitating the worship practices of the displaced nations
context_note: Read verse 4 with the preceding removal of pagan worship sites and verse 31’s explicit rejection of practices including child sacrifice.
verse_text: [12:4] You shall not do so unto the Lord your God,
maimonides: N65: Do not destroy holy places or erase God's name

title: Bring the prescribed holy gifts and vowed offerings to the Lord’s chosen place
original_audience: Israelite worshipers bringing prescribed sacrifices, sacred gifts and vows to the place the Lord chooses
context_note: The law specifies where the listed holy gifts and vows must be brought and specifies treatment of the offerings there. C1015 concerns unauthorized sites for burnt offerings, and C1016 concerns eating reserved foods in towns.
verse_text: [12:5] but unto the place which the Lord your God shall choose in one of your tribes, to set His name there, that it may be called upon, you shall seek and come thither. [12:6] And you shall bring thither your whole burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your firstfruits, and your vowed offerings, and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your cattle and of your sheep. [12:11] And it shall be, at the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there, you shall bring thither all that I command you this day: your whole burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and the firstfruits of your hands, and your gifts, and all the choice gifts which you shall vow unto your God. [12:26] Only your holy things which you have, and your vowed offerings, you shall take, and come unto the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there. [12:27] And you shall prepare your whole burnt offerings; you shall offer the flesh upon the altar of the Lord your God, and you shall pour the blood of your sacrifices against the base of the altar of the Lord your God; and you shall eat the flesh.
maimonides: P83: Bring vowed and freewill offerings at the next pilgrimage festival
P85: Bring offerings from outside the Land to the sanctuary

title: Eat the prescribed sacred meals at God's chosen place with the eligible household and dependants
original_audience: Israelite worshipers and their households at the Lord’s chosen place
verse_text: [12:7] And you shall eat there before the Lord your God, and rejoice in all that you put your hand unto, you and your houses, because the Lord your God has blessed you.

title: Do not make personal preference the rule of covenant worship
original_audience: Israelite worshipers entering the land
verse_text: [12:8] You shall not do all that we do here this day, every man that which is pleasing in his own sight; [12:9] for you have not yet come unto the rest and unto the inheritance which the Lord your God gives you.

title: Do not offer burnt offerings at unauthorized places
original_audience: Israelites bringing burnt offerings
verse_text: [12:13] Take heed unto yourself, that you do not offer your whole burnt offerings in every place that you see,
maimonides: N89: Do not offer sacrifices outside the chosen place

title: You may slaughter and eat meat locally, clean and unclean alike
original_audience: Israel
context_note: Moses, relaying the Lord addresses Israel in this passage.
verse_text: [12:15] Nevertheless, you may slaughter and eat flesh according to all your desire, according to the blessing of the Lord your God which He has given you in every city. The unclean among you and the clean may eat it together, as the gazelle or the deer. [12:20] And if the Lord your God enlarges your borders, as He has spoken unto you, and you say: I will eat flesh, because your soul desires to eat flesh, you may eat flesh according to all the desire of your soul. [12:21] And if the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there is too far from you, you shall slaughter of your cattle and of your sheep which God has given you, as I commanded you, and eat within your cities according to the desire of your soul. [12:22] As the gazelle and the deer are eaten, so you shall eat it; the unclean among you and the clean shall eat it alike.
maimonides: P86: Redeem consecrated animals that became blemished
P146: Slaughter animals by the prescribed method before eating

title: Pour the blood from meat slaughtered for food onto the ground
original_audience: Israelite households slaughtering and eating animals for food in their towns
context_note: These verses direct how to dispose of blood in the context of ordinary meat. The existing consumption ban in C0019 and the rule about covering blood after hunting in C0574 describe distinct requirements.
verse_text: [12:16] Only you shall not eat the blood; you shall pour it upon the earth as water. [12:24] You shall not eat it; you shall pour it upon the earth as water.

title: Do not eat the reserved sacred foods in ordinary towns instead of the chosen sanctuary
original_audience: Israelites with the listed sacred produce and offerings
verse_text: [12:17] You may not eat within your cities the tithe of your grain, or of your wine, or of your oil, nor the firstborn of your cattle or of your sheep, nor any of the vows which you shall vow, nor your pledged offerings, nor the firstfruits of your hands; [12:18] but you shall eat them before the Lord your God, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for Himself, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male slave, and your female slave, and the sojourner within your cities. And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God in all that you put your hand unto.
maimonides: P128: Separate the second tithe for eating in Jerusalem
N141: Do not eat second-tithe grain outside Jerusalem
N142: Do not drink second-tithe wine outside Jerusalem
N143: Do not consume second-tithe oil outside Jerusalem
N144: Do not eat an unblemished firstborn outside Jerusalem
N146: Do not eat the meat of a burnt offering
N147: Do not eat lesser offerings before their blood is sprinkled
N148: Priests must not eat firstfruits before placing them in the court

title: Do not neglect the Levite
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite households in the land
verse_text: [12:19] Take heed unto yourself, that you do not forsake the Levite all the time that you live upon the land.
maimonides: N229: Do not neglect giving the Levites their dues

title: Do not inquire into other gods' worship in order to imitate it
original_audience: Israel in the land
verse_text: [12:30] take heed unto yourself, that you do not seek to follow them after they have been destroyed from before you. You shall not inquire after their gods, saying: How do these nations serve their gods? I also will do so.

title: Do not heed an enticement to serve other gods, even from a wonder-worker or close relative
original_audience: Israel
verse_text: [13:4] you shall not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or unto that dreamer of dreams; for the Lord God tests you, to know whether you love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
maimonides: N17: Do not love the enticer to idolatry
N18: Do not stop hating the enticer to idolatry
N28: Do not listen to a prophet speaking for idolatry

title: Apply the prescribed death judgment to the prophet who entices Israel into apostasy
original_audience: Israel as the covenant community
verse_text: [13:6] And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall die; for he spoke to lead you astray from the Lord your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you from bondage, to thrust you out of the way wherein the Lord your God commanded you to walk. And you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.
maimonides: N26: Do not prophesy in the name of other gods

title: Do not spare the proven enticer to idolatry out of personal attachment
original_audience: The Israelite approached by a close enticer
verse_text: [13:9] you shall not consent unto him, neither shall you hearken unto him; neither shall your eye spare him, nor shall you yearn for him, nor conceal him.
maimonides: N17: Do not love the enticer to idolatry
N19: Do not save the enticer from death
N20: Do not plead in the enticer's defense

title: Report the secret enticer to idolatry and do not conceal him
original_audience: The Israelite approached by a close relative or friend who secretly entices that person to serve other gods
verse_text: [13:9] you shall not consent unto him, neither shall you hearken unto him; neither shall your eye spare him, nor shall you yearn for him, nor conceal him. [13:10] You shall surely report him; your hands shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people.
maimonides: N21: Do not withhold incriminating evidence against the enticer

title: Apply the prescribed death judgment to the proven enticer to idolatry
original_audience: Israel's covenant community in the established enticement case
verse_text: [13:11] And they shall stone him with stones, and he shall die; for he sought to turn you away from the Lord your God, who brought you forth out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.
maimonides: N16: Do not entice an individual to idolatry

title: Investigate a city's reported apostasy diligently
original_audience: Israelite authorities investigating a report of apostasy in one of Israel’s towns
verse_text: [13:13] And if you hear it said in one of your cities which the Lord your God gives you to dwell in, [13:14] Lawless men have gone forth from among you, and have turned aside all the inhabitants of their city, saying: Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known, [13:15] then you shall inquire and search diligently; and behold, if the matter is clearly true, and this abomination has been done among you,
maimonides: P179: Examine witnesses thoroughly

title: Carry out the prescribed destruction judgment on the proven apostate city
original_audience: Israel acting in the established apostate-city case
verse_text: [13:16] you shall surely slay all the inhabitants of that city with the sword; you shall utterly devote it to destruction, and all that is therein.

title: Do not rebuild the condemned apostate city
original_audience: Israel regarding the condemned city
verse_text: [13:17] And you shall gather all its spoil into its streets, and burn the city with fire, and all its spoil, all together before the Lord your God; and it shall be uninhabited for ever, and shall not be built again.
maimonides: N23: Do not rebuild the apostate city

title: Do not retain the condemned apostate city's devoted property
original_audience: Israel carrying out the prescribed city judgment
verse_text: [13:18] And nothing of that which is devoted to destruction shall cleave to your hand, that the Lord may turn from the fierceness of His wrath, and grant you mercy, and have mercy upon you, and multiply you, as the Lord sware unto your fathers,
maimonides: N24: Do not benefit from the apostate city's property

title: Do not make a mourning bald patch for the dead
original_audience: The Israelites whom Moses addresses as sons of the Lord
context_note: Text and setting: Israelite distinction
verse_text: [14:1] You are sons of the Lord your God; you shall not perform purification rites, neither shall you make a bald place between your eyes for the dead. [14:2] For you are a holy people unto the Lord your God; and the Lord your God has chosen you to be unto Him a people for His own possession, out of all the nations upon the face of the earth.
maimonides: N171: Do not make a bald spot in mourning for the dead

title: You may eat every clean bird
original_audience: Israel
context_note: the Lord through Moses addresses Israel in this passage.
verse_text: [14:11] Every clean bird you may eat.
maimonides: P150: Eat only clean birds, distinguishing them by their signs

title: Do not eat an animal that dies of itself
original_audience: Israelites observing the food prohibition, with the resident alien and foreigner named as possible recipients
context_note: The text forbids Israelites to eat what dies of itself and directs that it be given to a resident alien to eat or sold to a foreigner. The prohibition on boiling a lamb in its mother’s milk is a separate clause.
verse_text: [14:21] You shall not eat anything that dies of itself; it shall be given unto the resident alien within your cities, and he shall eat it, or you may sell it unto a foreigner; for you are a holy people unto the Lord your God. You shall not boil a lamb in its mother’s milk.
maimonides: N180: Do not eat an animal that died by itself

title: Set aside the annual produce tithe and eat it at the chosen place
original_audience: Israelite households responsible for the annual produce tithe and its prescribed meal
context_note: The law expressly requires tithing the field’s produce year by year and consuming the named sacred produce at the chosen place. It differs from the third-year local distribution in C1034 and the tithe assigned to Levites in Numbers 18.
verse_text: [14:22] You shall surely tithe all the produce of your seed, the yield of your field, year by year. [14:23] And you shall eat it before the Lord your God, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there. You shall bring the tithes of your grain, and of your wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your cattle and of your sheep, that you may learn to fear the Lord your God all your days.
maimonides: P128: Separate the second tithe for eating in Jerusalem

title: Use the prescribed silver substitute if distance prevents carrying the festival tithe
topic: Land, harvests and provision for the poor
original_audience: Israelite tithe bearers for whom the chosen place is too far to carry the produce
verse_text: [14:24] And if the way is too long for you, so that you cannot carry them, because the place which the Lord your God shall choose for His name to be called upon there is far from you, when the Lord your God has blessed you, [14:25] then you shall sell them for silver, and take the silver in your hands, and go unto the place which the Lord your God shall choose. [14:26] And you shall spend the silver for whatsoever your soul desires, for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever your soul desires; and you shall eat there before the Lord your God, and rejoice, you and your house,

title: Deposit the third-year produce tithe locally for Levites, resident foreigners, orphans and widows

title: Eat the unblemished firstborn animals yearly at the Lord’s chosen place
original_audience: Israelite owners of firstborn male cattle or sheep and their households
context_note: Verse 20 expressly prescribes a household meal before God each year at the chosen place. Verse 21 excludes a blemished animal from sacrifice. The subsequent local provision for a blemished firstborn is separately itemized.
verse_text: [15:19] Every firstborn male that is born among your cattle and among your sheep you shall sanctify unto the Lord your God. You shall do no work with your firstborn calf, neither shall you shear the firstborn of your sheep. [15:20] You shall eat it before the Lord, year by year, in the place which the Lord your God shall choose, you and your house. [15:21] And if there is a blemish in it, lameness or blindness or any grievous blemish, you shall not sacrifice it unto the Lord your God.

context_note: The blemished firstborn must not be sacrificed. Unlike the sacred meal for an unblemished firstborn, this meat may be eaten locally by clean and unclean Israelites.
verse_text: [15:21] And if there is a blemish in it, lameness or blindness or any grievous blemish, you shall not sacrifice it unto the Lord your God. [15:22] You shall eat it within your cities; the unclean among you and the clean shall eat it alike, as the gazelle or the deer.

title: Stone the man or woman proven to have served other gods
original_audience: Israel's local courts
context_note: The sentence belongs to Israel's court process. An investigation and testimony of two or three witnesses are required, and the witnesses act first.
verse_text: [17:2] And if there is found among you, within any of your cities which the Lord your God gives you, a man or a woman who does evil before the Lord your God, transgressing His covenant, [17:3] and they go and serve other gods, and bow down unto them, unto the sun, or unto the moon, or unto any of the array of heaven, which He has not commanded, [17:4] and it is told you, you shall inquire diligently; and behold, if the matter is true, and this abomination has been done in Israel, [17:5] then you shall bring forth that man or that woman, and you shall stone them with stones, and they shall die. [17:6] Upon the testimony of two witnesses or three witnesses shall he who is condemned to death be put to death; he shall not die upon the testimony of one witness. [17:7] And the hand of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people; and you shall remove the evil one from among yourselves.

[17:9] And you shall come unto the Levitical priests, and unto the judge who shall be in those days; and they shall inquire, and declare unto you the judgment.
